purpose: Concept proposals only; no Unreal assets or levels implemented.
base_prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished game environment concept sheet for the alien survival/base-building strategy game Survive the Planet, NOT an actual screenshot or implemented asset. Warm dusty tan ground, dark weathered basalt boulders and broken low rock ridges, clusters of red coral-like alien shrubs, orange trumpet plants, sparse olive-green rosettes, fine rubble. Ground-level terrain, not floating islands, no cliffs around the entire perimeter. High readability, soft warm daylight with short shadows, realistic stylized Unreal game art. No HUD, no buildings, people, water, roads, bridges, crystals or new biome assets. Clear tasteful typography on a charcoal presentation-board background. Maintain navigable open ground and broad buildable clearings, about 60-70 percent of each sector unobstructed. Footprints are organic ground-placement regions, NOT solid raised plateaus or enclosed walls.
Shared shape library: 01 tapered bent tongue; 02 gently curved broad ribbon; 03 long asymmetric broken ridge ribbon; 04 very slender tapered ridge ribbon; 05 asymmetric two-pronged fork; 06 small rounded irregular island. These first six are conceptual approximations of existing shapes, not redesigns. NEW shapes: 07 deep crescent with tapered horns and a large open concavity; 08 wide squat irregular kidney-shaped island; 09 bent L/elbow with rounded organic arms; 10 long winding S ribbon, both ends tapered; 11 open U/horseshoe with a broad accessible pocket and very widely separated ends; 12 broad asymmetric three-lobed fan, short spreading fingers, no perfect radial symmetry. Distinct recognisable silhouettes, filled with rocks/plants but patchy natural edges.
Asset type: landscape concept-art library sheet, high resolution. Title exactly "PLACERINGSYTOR 01–12"; small subtitle "6 befintliga principer + 6 nya förslag". Twelve equally sized tiles arranged four columns by three rows, numbered in reading order 01 through 12 exactly once. Each tile shows ONE reusable footprint region orthographically from directly overhead, in the same absolute ground scale; use organic rock/plant textures within each silhouette and a thin clearly visible cyan boundary contour enclosing it, surrounded by empty neutral sand fading to the tile margin. No sector hexagons here. Label under each with exactly: "01 Avsmalnande", "02 Böjd remsa", "03 Lång rygg", "04 Smal rygg", "05 Gaffel", "06 Liten ö", "07 Halvmåne", "08 Bred ö", "09 Vinkel", "10 S-form", "11 Hästsko", "12 Solfjäder". Mark tiles 07–12 with a small amber "NY" tag. All silhouettes clearly distinct: e.g. 07 a single curved crescent vs 11 a U around a wider deep pocket. Keep connecting arms thick enough for placement of boulders. Subtle scale note bottom "Koncept • former och skala justeras i editorn". Beautiful concise production-art sheet, no dense text, no decorative maps.

Asset type: landscape concept-art sheet with THREE equally sized panels side by side. Main title "SEKTORMALLAR 01–03". Each panel shows one entire identical regular SIX-SIDED hexagonal sector from the SAME very high isometric camera angle, same apparent dimensions and zoom, with a thin cyan perimeter line. True hexagons, no pentagons and no giant rectangular terrain slab. Sector design scale is corner-to-center radius 40 m, corner-to-corner 80 m; no dimension arrows needed. Show all six corners. At bottom of EACH panel place a small clean directly-overhead thumbnail matching that panel's layout, cyan simple region contours on warm sand, with small readable region IDs inside their matching footprints. Main render must match thumbnail. The number-coded shapes must remain individually discernible rather than fused into whole perimeter walls.
Panel 1 label "01 Öppen bas" and below "01 · 02 · 03 · 04 · 05 · 06": preserve the starting-sector principle of six peripheral organic strips around a LARGE completely open central construction space, elongated shapes mostly following sides but with generous gaps, short blob near the lower edge, a forked band lower-left and curved long seams flanking right. This is the existing-sector-inspired reference, not a brand-new layout.
Panel 2 label "02 Bred passage" and below "03 · 04 · 07 · 09 · 06 · 08": distinct layout where a broad open diagonal passage connects two opposing sector edges, a deep crescent 07 and long ribbon 03 frame one side, L-shaped 09 and slender 04 frame the other; a small 06 and wide 08 island offset along edges. Two generous construction bays open off the central passage. No continuous wall and no pinched dead ends.
Panel 3 label "03 Öar och fickor" and below "06 · 08 · 10 · 12 · 06 · 08": visibly different more fragmented arrangement, two wide kidney islands 08, two small blobs 06, one winding short S region10 near an edge, one broad three-lobed fan12 on an opposite edge. Broad connected open ground snakes BETWEEN islands, multiple asymmetrical buildable pockets rather than a perimeter ring. Six individual placement regions total. Keep approximately 65 percent sand open.
Small footer "Koncept • samma sektorsstorlek • återanvändbara placeringsytor". No further text. Make the three layouts visibly different at a glance while using same art assets and palette.

Panel 1 label "04 Skyddad ficka" and below "11 · 02 · 09 · 06 · 04": five separate organic placement regions. A pronounced open U-shaped horseshoe11, composed of discontinuous boulders with plants, frames a large EMPTY construction pocket slightly left of center, mouth broad and open toward foreground. A curved strip02 along rear-left edge; L/elbow09 on right edge; slender ridge04 near rear-right; small blob06 near lower-right. All regions separated by wide accessible gaps, no completely closed ring. Wide outer circulation path remains.
Panel 2 label "05 Slingrande stråk" and below "10 · 01 · 03 · 07 · 08 · 06": six distinct regions; one long winding S ribbon10 runs across the middle off-axis, dividing but NEVER fully sealing two large building bays. Short tapered01 and long03 peripheral on one side, crescent07 on another edge, wide island08 and small06 at opposite ends. Several wide crossings around the S ends; winding open passage remains continuous. This should read as a serpentine central rock/plant seam, not a straight canyon.

Three generously sized EMPTY buildable clearings linked by broad routes around the central fan, organic asymmetry, no perfect three-way radial symmetry, no tight maze. Six independent footprints.
Small footer "Koncept • samma sektorsstorlek • återanvändbara placeringsytor". No extra text. Rock and vegetation density confined to footprints, large usable open spaces. Three layouts visually unmistakably different.
refinements: Edit this concept sheet only in tile 07 Halvmåne (second row, third column). Preserve the entire sheet, typography, all labels, numbers, all other eleven tiles, camera, palette and materials unchanged. Change footprint07 from the current nearly U/horseshoe shape to a SHALLOW swept crescent, approximately a 90–110 degree bow, open upward, much wider than it is deep, thick at the center and tapering to two widely separated pointed ends. It must be unmistakably different from tile11 which remains a deep U/horseshoe. Cyan contour encloses just this shallow organic crescent; rocks/orange plants match existing visual style. No additional text or alterations.

Edit this three-panel concept sheet ONLY in the leftmost panel 01 Öppen bas. Preserve all titles and all of panels02 and03 exactly unchanged. Panel01 currently mistakenly shows SEVEN separate placement regions and two shapes labelled06. Remove the small extra rock/plant island in the upper-right part of the LARGE left sector render, just below the upper-right perimeter edge. Replace only that small island by plain ground matching surrounding sand. In the matching SMALL left plan thumbnail, remove the small upper-right rounded footprint labelled06 and replace its cyan outline and numeral with plain sand. Retain the bottom-center 06 small island, and all other shapes01,02,03,04,05. Final left sector and its thumbnail must each have exactly six distinct footprint regions, each of the numbers01 through06 exactly once in the thumbnail. Preserve everything else: layout, dimensions, color, lighting, existing rock/plant clusters and lower labels. Do not remove the upper long band02 or the long right band03.
